title: toast writing formulas
name: Toast writing formulas — Spectrum
rule: Confirmation (neutral/positive): optional noun + past-participle -ed + optional prepositional phrase; UI element names in bold. Informational: complete sentence (subject + verb + optional extra). Error: short phrase + in-line action when possible. Keep under 2 lines in English (localization grows).
pass_when: Copy matches the confirmation / informational / error formula; under 2 lines in English; UI names bold on confirmation.
fail_when: Wrong formula for the toast type, or more than 2 lines in English.
overview: Toast copy follows confirmation, informational, or error formulas and stays under two English lines.
apply_when: Drafting Spectrum toast strings for confirmations, info, or errors.
not_when: Long help articles, multi-step wizards, or dialog body copy.
agent_hint: Match toast type formulas; keep under two English lines and bold UI names on confirmations.
description: Spectrum toast formulas differ by type: confirmations use optional noun plus past-participle -ed plus optional prepositional phrase with UI names in bold; informational toasts are complete sentences; errors are short phrases with an in-line action when possible. Keep English copy under two lines because localization grows. Wrong formulas or multi-line walls of toast text fail the writing pattern.
